page.layout: One engraved portrait on the page, with an oval inscription band around the sitter and a cartouche at the foot of the oval. No text outside the engraving.

main_text.l: ILLUSTR. ET POT. PRIN. CAROLUS PRINCEPS WALLIÆ
DUX CORNW. ET EBOR. ALB. ET ROTH. MARCH. ORME[?]

page.notes: Engraved portrait of a young man in armour and a falling lace collar, half-length, turned to the viewer's right. The inscription runs clockwise round the oval, starting top left after a rosette: "ILLUSTR. ET POT. PRIN. CAROLUS PRINCEPS WALLIÆ" down the right side and across the bottom, then "DUX CORNW. ET EBOR. ALB. ET ROTH. MARCH. ORME" up the left side. The letters at the bottom and the ends of both lines are partly worn, so "ORME" and "WALLIÆ" are marked as doubtful. At the foot of the oval is a small cartouche with a crowned emblem, which carries no legible text. Above the engraving is a dark stain and offset spots from another page; these are not printed text and are left out. The lower right corner has a digitiser's line ("Digitized by Google"), which is left out.
